phase_definitions.later: Planned expansion, not a launch gate
phase_definitions.deferred: Explicitly held pending readiness/free alternative/new decision

basis_definitions.user_direction: Explicit direction preserved from the conversation
basis_definitions.recorded_product_direction: Established planning direction; not a separately approved full PRD

requirements.title: Navigation and orientation
requirements.requirement: Offer a broad subject entrance alongside Places, Odisha in Numbers, Stories and Contribute; retain food, handlooms and tourism as featured collections.
acceptance_criteria: A reader can reach a populated health or education page and an economy page through subjects without entering a tourism journey.
Search, editorial standards and contribution routes remain accessible.
Empty future collections are not presented as working destinations.

requirements.title: Useful site search
requirements.requirement: Search only approved public entries, with type/place/language context and a helpful no-results state.
acceptance_criteria: A known pilot article and a photo caption can be found.
A no-result query invites a contribution and does not imply the subject does not exist.
Pending and private records never appear.

requirements.title: Names and language status
requirements.requirement: Support reviewed Odia names, aliases and historic spellings without silently equating distinct places or regions.
acceptance_criteria: Pilot searches cover reviewed English and Odia names and one recorded alias.
A missing translation is explicitly unavailable, not silently substituted as a reviewed translation.

requirements.title: Connected reading
requirements.requirement: Connect entries across subjects using stable concept IDs and explain why each related page is useful.
acceptance_criteria: The Painted Streets story links to its place and individual photos.
A fisheries page can lead to food, exports and coastal nature with the relationship explained; association is not presented as a proved supply chain or cause.
A health or education explainer connects to another relevant subject without implying causal evidence.
The same canonical entry is reused across gateways without conflicting copies.

requirements.title: Subject classification and dimensions
requirements.requirement: Classify canonical knowledge with one primary subject and optional secondary subjects, keeping format, geography, period and evidence state as separate dimensions.
acceptance_criteria: All public subject IDs resolve to stable subject hubs; a record can appear in more than one collection without duplication.
All atlas topics map to a subject, and related-reading links resolve with an explanation.
Classification never grants publication approval or changes a source-check date.

requirements.title: Entry structure
requirements.requirement: Provide an accessible summary, factual context, subject classification, meaningful dates, sources, explained related knowledge and a correction action.
acceptance_criteria: Each pilot entry has the required public fields and no unresolved placeholder presented as a fact.
Non-tourism pilot pages explain what their facts measure and what they cannot establish.

requirements.title: Evidence and uncertainty
requirements.requirement: Distinguish documented facts, measured data, testimony, folklore, interpretation and announcements.
acceptance_criteria: Material qualifications sit next to the claim.
A planned project is not labelled operational and an oral account is not labelled independently verified.

requirements.title: Citations and credit
requirements.requirement: Preserve Utkal collection credit and original source, photographer, translator and contributor attribution.
acceptance_criteria: Readers can locate a source and the chosen public photo credit.
Citation text includes entry identity and revision/date context.
No human reviewer or institutional endorsement is claimed without evidence.

requirements.title: Photographic archive
requirements.requirement: Publish a credited Painted Streets collection and approved individual display images from the existing archive.
acceptance_criteria: A photo has a stable ID, contextual caption, date/location precision, credit and rights state.
Unknown artist/location remains unknown; unrelated event photos do not appear as mural evidence.
Private metadata and email details are excluded from display copies and public Git.

requirements.title: Readable data stories
requirements.requirement: Explain public numbers across the encyclopedia with the measure, unit, period, geography, comparison basis and source.
acceptance_criteria: A pilot data story makes one main takeaway readable and exposes its evidence.
Health/education and economy reading cases provide concise interpretation and contextual links, with detailed tables available as evidence.
Downloadable values preserve estimate/provisional labels and do not mix incomparable periods.

requirements.title: Content freshness
requirements.requirement: Track source-check, editorial-review and publication dates separately; specify a review trigger for changing information.
acceptance_criteria: Time-sensitive pilot notes carry a dated check or an explicit not-reconfirmed label.
A machine check does not populate a human-review badge.

requirements.title: Guest text proposals
requirements.requirement: Accept corrections or knowledge proposals without requiring a GitHub account.
acceptance_criteria: A guest can submit permitted text fields through the site and receive success only after the save is confirmed.
Failed or denied saves are visible; retries do not silently create duplicate records.

requirements.title: Photo contribution path
requirements.requirement: Receive photographs in the editorial inbox; offer a free relay only after it is activated and tested.
acceptance_criteria: A permitted sample reaches the inbox with caption and credit; otherwise expose direct email as the launch path.
The form discloses forwarding and publication review; relay acceptance is not described as publication or guaranteed inbox delivery.
Oversize/failure states offer an email fallback; opening an email draft never produces a sent confirmation.

requirements.title: Git contribution route
requirements.requirement: Provide contribution guidance and a reviewed Git change route, with maintainer permissions reserved for approved collaborators.
acceptance_criteria: A sample public-safe change passes through checks and review before publication.
The guide explains that public forks may propose changes without collaborator status.
Untrusted checks cannot access deployment credentials.

requirements.title: Editorial queue
requirements.requirement: Track received, triaged, needs-information, accepted, published, rejected and withdrawn outcomes through an appropriate private record.
acceptance_criteria: A test correction can be traced from its intake record to the published concept/revision.
The inbox is the photo queue; the UI never claims automatic inbox/Firestore synchronisation.
Accepted does not mean published; rejected material is not sent to public Git.

requirements.title: Publication permission
requirements.requirement: Record contributor-selected credit and permission before publishing submitted material.
acceptance_criteria: An editor can locate permission and credit for each accepted submission.
A missing right/permission blocks publication without requiring contact/consent text to be public.

requirements.title: Corrections and withdrawal requests
requirements.requirement: Provide a contact route for corrections, credit changes and withdrawal requests, with documented handling.
acceptance_criteria: A correction is recorded against the stable entry ID and material changes have a public revision note.
Withdrawal handling explains that previously public Git history and third-party copies may persist; do not promise complete erasure.

requirements.title: Explicit publication approval
requirements.requirement: Approve the exact public content and media revision; research lifecycle status is insufficient.
acceptance_criteria: A content change invalidates its earlier approval.
A source or media dependency change identifies affected publication approvals.
Unapproved or blocked items cannot enter a release.

requirements.title: One canonical knowledge collection
requirements.requirement: Keep the existing OKF concept paths and source records authoritative; generate pages and public tables from them.
acceptance_criteria: One source update yields consistent public outputs.
Generated JSON/SQLite is reproducible from the reviewed source and is not separately hand-maintained.

requirements.title: Private-data exclusion
requirements.requirement: Exclude private contacts, raw proposals, consent and credentials from public Git history and every public export.
acceptance_criteria: Fixtures representing private/draft data are absent from pages, search, downloads, previews and build logs.
Publication checks inspect the selected repository scope as well as the final website artifact.

requirements.title: Release identity and rollback
requirements.requirement: Publish a complete build with source revision and schema identity; retain a known-good public release.
acceptance_criteria: A failed build leaves the prior release available.
Rollback restores a known public release and its matching data/search assets.
Renamed entry IDs resolve through explicit redirects or retirement records.

requirements.title: Enforced roles
requirements.requirement: Use Firebase Authentication and Security Rules to restrict user and reviewer data access.
acceptance_criteria: A guest cannot self-approve, grant roles, read another private record or overwrite an approved public record.
Rules tests cover unauthenticated, contributor and reviewer cases.
Public client code holds no privileged write or model credential.

requirements.title: Data minimisation
requirements.requirement: Collect only fields needed for review and explain access, use and retention.
acceptance_criteria: Contact/permission fields have a defined private destination.
Review interfaces avoid raw submission content in telemetry or URLs.
No living-family/DNA collection is implied by a generic photo or correction form.

requirements.title: Honest failure states
requirements.requirement: Preserve public reading during private service failure and state clearly when a save or send failed.
acceptance_criteria: With Firebase or the relay unavailable, static pages/search still work.
The contributor receives a retry or alternate-route instruction rather than a false success.

requirements.title: Mobile and keyboard access
requirements.requirement: Make primary reading, search and contribution journeys usable on small screens and by keyboard.
acceptance_criteria: Representative pages at a 360px viewport and enlarged text keep essential controls usable without clipped content.
Forms have labels, visible focus and accessible error messages; informative photos have meaningful alternative text.
A keyboard-only tester completes search and a correction journey.

requirements.title: Lightweight public reading
requirements.requirement: Deliver static pages and load optimised images and interactive code only as needed.
acceptance_criteria: Ordinary reading/search does not require a Firestore read for each entry.
Measure pilot page transfer and mobile performance; document image/code reductions before release.
Avoid automatic loading of full photo originals across the gallery.

requirements.title: Consent-aware GA4
requirements.requirement: Measure approved public interactions only after affirmative analytics consent.
acceptance_criteria: Declining analytics permits reading and contributions and sends no GA requests.
Accepted-consent tests show one intended event per action with safe parameters.
Raw searches, emails, family narratives, submission text and private record IDs do not enter GA4.

requirements.title: Outcome and editorial measures
requirements.requirement: Measure useful discovery, source use, corrections, coverage and contribution outcomes without equating traffic to impact.
acceptance_criteria: The measurement register defines each metric and its evidence source.
Relay acceptance, inbox receipt, editorial acceptance and publication are separate counts.
Targets remain proposed until a real baseline is measured.

requirements.title: Domain and static hosting
requirements.requirement: Use GitHub Pages with the user-owned domain and HTTPS.
acceptance_criteria: Both chosen domain variants resolve as intended, canonical redirect and HTTPS work, and key deep links survive reload.
Domain ownership and renewal responsibility are recorded privately.

requirements.title: Free launch services
requirements.requirement: Stay on Spark and free public hosting/relay allowances; do not enable Blaze or paid AI/backup services for launch.
acceptance_criteria: A launch checklist records active products and confirms no paid feature is required by the delivered flows.
Quota exhaustion behaviour is documented and tested where practical.
The budget explicitly excludes domain renewal and existing tools/labour; $0 is conditional on free allowances.

requirements.title: Knowledge maintenance
requirements.requirement: Reuse the existing KB validators and weekly data-editor process when its remote integration is ready.
acceptance_criteria: A representative update passes structure/source checks and follows publication approval rules.
No duplicate scheduled editor is created.
A source refresh does not overwrite historical observations without a documented revision.

requirements.title: Versioned PRD history
requirements.requirement: Maintain a current PRD, stable requirement IDs, frozen baselines and an append-only revision register.
acceptance_criteria: The initial snapshot and its requirements snapshot match stored checksums.
A later change records IDs, rationale, decision basis, scope and approval status without overwriting older baselines.
Every release can identify the PRD baseline it implements.

requirements.title: Heritage and global connections atlas
requirements.requirement: Publish source-qualified historical migration, language, trade, religion, material-culture and diaspora connections.
acceptance_criteria: Each connection exposes subject, relationship, place/period, source and evidence assessment.
Similarity is not labelled descent or influence; historical boundaries are dated.
Maps draw routes only when evidence supports routes.

requirements.title: Consented family histories
requirements.requirement: Offer opt-in family/migration intake only after consent, private handling and review are ready.
acceptance_criteria: Participants control permitted public credit and publication scope.
No ancestry, caste, ethnicity or religion is inferred from surnames; no DNA intake is introduced.
Private evidence stays outside public exports and AI retrieval.

requirements.title: Ask Utkal
requirements.requirement: Answer from the approved KB with Utkal and original-source credit, only after a viable free option or agreed budget.
acceptance_criteria: Answerable evaluation cases cite supporting retrieved passages and carry release identity.
Missing/disputed evidence produces qualification or abstention.
No private-data leaks or invented citations; evaluate English and Odia with appropriate review.

requirements.title: Research internships
requirements.requirement: Develop supervised learning opportunities with defined research assignments and credited outputs.
acceptance_criteria: A named supervisor, learning outcomes, work arrangement, funding and host/programme eligibility are resolved before recruitment.
No academic credit, placement, compensation or university affiliation is advertised without actual arrangements.

requirements.title: Institutional relationships
requirements.requirement: Track candidate cultural, academic, archive and diaspora relationships and agreed activities.
acceptance_criteria: Candidate, contacted, pilot-agreed and active statuses are distinct.
Public partnership claims require an agreement; private contacts remain private.
Outreach is sent only under explicit authorisation.

requirements.title: Managed photo intake and automation
requirements.requirement: Consider Blaze uploads/functions when observed manual burden or reliability problems justify it.
acceptance_criteria: An acceptable cost decision precedes enabling billing.
Save receipts, retry handling, access and reviewed Git export pass tests.
Email migration preserves consent, attribution and submission identity.

requirements.title: Independent private recovery
requirements.requirement: Revisit private backups when a suitable free option or a revised budget is established.
acceptance_criteria: Recovery scope includes records, identity configuration and files as applicable.
A protected independent copy is actually restored in a test before a recovery promise is made.
Current launch materials do not imply Git backs up Firebase or inbox contents.

requirements.title: Broader language and geographic coverage
requirements.requirement: Expand districts, communities and reviewed language editions using a transparent coverage matrix.
acceptance_criteria: Coverage records distinguish missing, researching, reviewing, published and overdue.
A missing record is described as a collection gap rather than cultural absence.
Translated material retains its own provenance and review state.

requirements.title: Personal collections
requirements.requirement: Offer optional saved entries and preferences when user need justifies accounts.
acceptance_criteria: A saved item references a stable concept ID, survives authorised sign-in and resolves renamed/retired entries clearly.
Public reading never requires registration.

requirements.title: District opportunity discovery
requirements.requirement: Provide place-linked business opportunities across districts and sectors for local and outside entrepreneurs.
acceptance_criteria: Each opportunity references canonical place/sector records and distinguishes assets from validated demand.
District coverage shows unknown and unresearched fields; no unsupported best-district ranking.

requirements.title: Actionable business dossiers
requirements.requirement: Connect demand, regulations, premises, people, support and economics for a specified business model.
acceptance_criteria: Permissions retain applicability, original rules/amendments, authority and check dates; unresolved rules stay visible.
Land listings, workforce directories and schemes do not imply availability, consent, title or eligibility.
Financial scenarios preserve dated quotes, assumptions, working capital and downside results.

requirements.title: Portable personal project books
requirements.requirement: Let readers assemble and export a sourced business research book and a clearly labelled personal plan.
acceptance_criteria: Export retains edition, citations, check dates, unknowns and user assumptions in readable print/PDF and portable data.
Private budgets, identities, negotiations and personal notes are excluded from public Git and analytics.
Long-book pagination and data round-trip are tested before claiming implementation; template is not lender approval.

requirements.title: Opportunity maintenance and outcomes
requirements.requirement: Maintain district business research without overstating local economic benefits.
acceptance_criteria: Track evidence freshness, research state and public-release state separately.
Use actual evidence for business launches, jobs and producer returns; plans and downloads are not economic outcomes.
Commercial relationships are disclosed and do not purchase favourable ratings.
